说明: 风格菜单：开新项目时从 styles 里选一个，把它的 style_prompt 和 negative_prompt 填进 storyboard.json 的 style 字段。所有画图都会自动带上，整部漫画风格统一。

styles.name: 商业漫画风（默认）
styles.look: 干净的线条 + 平涂上色，像银行/政务宣传漫画
styles.style_prompt: clean Chinese commercial comic style, soft clean lines, flat shading, bright warm colors, simple shapes
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, photorealistic, dark, horror
styles.suitable_for: 银行、政务、企业宣传，中老年受众

styles.name: 皮克斯 3D 动画风
styles.look: 圆滚滚的可爱 3D 人物，大眼，柔和光影，像动画电影截图
styles.style_prompt: Pixar style 3D animation render, cute round characters, big expressive eyes, soft cinematic lighting, subsurface scattering, high quality 3D render
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, 2d, flat, sketch, scary, realistic human
styles.suitable_for: 面向年轻人/儿童的宣传，轻松活泼的主题

styles.name: 素描手绘风
styles.look: 铅笔线条 + 淡彩，像手绘速写本
styles.style_prompt: hand-drawn pencil sketch style, light watercolor wash, visible pencil lines, paper texture, gentle and artistic
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, 3d render, photorealistic, heavy colors

styles.name: 水彩插画风
styles.look: 柔和的水彩晕染，颜色淡雅，像绘本
styles.style_prompt: soft watercolor illustration, gentle color bleeding, pastel palette, children's picture book style, warm and cozy
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, 3d, dark, harsh lines
styles.suitable_for: 温情故事、节日宣传、生活类主题

styles.name: 日式黑白漫画风
styles.look: 黑白网点纸漫画，像日本漫画书
styles.style_prompt: Japanese manga style, black and white, screentone shading, clean ink lines, dynamic composition
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, color, 3d, photorealistic
styles.suitable_for: 剧情感强、年轻人受众的连载内容

styles.name: Q版萌系风
styles.look: 二头身小人，超可爱，表情夸张
styles.style_prompt: chibi style, super deformed cute characters, big head small body, kawaii, simple bright colors, thick outlines
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, realistic proportions, dark, scary
styles.suitable_for: 轻松科普、表情包式宣传、社交媒体传播

styles.name: 扁平插画风
styles.look: 几何色块拼成的现代扁平插画，像互联网公司的宣传图
styles.style_prompt: modern flat vector illustration, geometric shapes, bold color blocks, minimal details, corporate Memphis style
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, 3d, realistic, sketch, gradients overload
styles.suitable_for: 金融、科技、制度说明类严肃内容

styles.name: 国风水墨风
styles.look: 水墨淡彩 + 国画线条，有中国传统韵味
styles.style_prompt: Chinese ink wash painting style, guofeng, elegant brush strokes, light color wash, traditional Chinese aesthetic, rice paper texture
styles.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, speech bubble, watermark, 3d, western comic, photorealistic
styles.suitable_for: 传统文化、节日、文博类主题
